blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) thanked the House of Representatives for approving its proposed P975.96 billion budget for 2027, which accounts for 13.55 percent of the P7.2-trillion national budget. “We deeply appreciate the House of Representatives’ strong commitment to education and the leadership of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. in advancing the country’s education agenda. This support will help us protect learners, support teachers, accelerate learning recovery, and improve learning outcomes across the country,” Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a DepEd statement on Tuesday.
